components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square, high-contrast action used when a task needs a clear completion point.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; padding: 13px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--black, #030404); color: var(--warm-white, #f2f0e9); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-dm-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 0.87rem; font-weight: 650; transition: background-color 220ms ease-out, color 220ms ease-out, transform 220ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #235f48; transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #29664e; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Line Field
components.description: Unboxed text field with a tracked label and bottom-rule focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 9px; color: var(--black, #030404); font-family: var(--font-dm-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 0 13px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #9b9e99; border-radius: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--black, #030404); caret-color: #33755a; font: inherit; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #6c706c; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: #29664e; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #29664e; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Compact tracked destinations with mint active and hover states.
components.html: WorkLabResumeContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(18px, 1.95vw, 30px); color: var(--warm-white, #f2f0e9); font-family: var(--font-dm-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.16em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 240ms ease-out; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { color: var(--mint, #a7e0c3); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { border-radius: 2px; outline: 2px solid var(--mint, #a7e0c3); outline-offset: 7px; }

components.name: Direct Link
components.description: Visible text link for contact routes and in-copy actions.
components.css: .ds-direct-link { color: var(--warm-white, #f2f0e9); font-family: var(--font-dm-sans), sans-serif; text-decoration-color: rgb(167 224 195 / 0.5); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.35em; transition: color 240ms ease-out; } .ds-direct-link:hover { color: var(--mint, #a7e0c3); } .ds-direct-link:focus-visible { border-radius: 2px; outline: 2px solid var(--mint, #a7e0c3); outline-offset: 7px; }

components.name: Project Row
components.description: Flat editorial project entry divided by hairlines instead of a filled card.

components.css: .ds-project-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(150px, 0.65fr) minmax(240px, 1.25fr) minmax(130px, 0.4fr); gap: clamp(24px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: baseline; padding: 32px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgb(242 240 233 / 0.22); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(242 240 233 / 0.22); color: var(--warm-white, #f2f0e9); font-family: var(--font-dm-sans), sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-project-row strong { font-family: var(--font-montserrat), sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.5vw, 2.8rem); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-project-row span { color: var(--muted, #8f918e); line-height: 1.55; } .ds-project-row small { justify-self: end; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-project-row:hover, .ds-project-row:focus-visible { color: var(--mint, #a7e0c3); transform: translateX(12px); } .ds-project-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mint, #a7e0c3); outline-offset: 7px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-project-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; } .ds-project-row small { justify-self: start; } }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is a restrained, near-black field in which proportion, typography, whitespace, and authentic work create the visual identity. The system should feel senior, calm, and intentional: expressive through scale and composition, never through a decorative theme or a client brand borrowed from the work.

Montserrat gives display language a precise architectural presence while DM Sans keeps reading and interaction copy clear. Warm-white type, subdued gray support copy, rare mint signals, hairline boundaries, and responsive editorial grids create continuity across landing, index, case-study, résumé, lab, and contact surfaces. Motion is quiet and brief, rewarding attention without becoming the subject.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas with warm, low-glare contrast.
Large Montserrat statements paired with highly readable DM Sans copy.
Hairlines, spacing, and alignment establish groups before containers do.
Mint is a scarce interaction signal, not a decorative wash.
Real artifacts lead inside project contexts; the portfolio shell stays visually neutral.
Responsive layouts preserve reading order and grouping instead of merely shrinking.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Mint marks interaction or emphasis; it does not become a large background, ornamental gradient, or client-themed palette.

rules.name: The Client Boundary Rule
rules.body: Project colors remain inside their own artifacts and case-study contexts and never redefine the portfolio shell.

rules.name: The Scale Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: Create hierarchy with type size, weight, line length, and placement before adding a new color, container, or effect.

rules.name: The Quiet Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case carries headings and actions; uppercase belongs to the wordmark, compact labels, and established acronyms rather than eyebrow headings.

rules.name: The Whitespace With Work Rule
rules.body: Empty space must clarify hierarchy, create atmosphere, or protect an artifact. If it weakens the relationship between neighboring content, reduce it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use alignment, tonal fields, and hairlines for structure; add a shadow only when an object truly sits above another plane.

rules.name: The No Soft Card Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce generic rounded cards, pills, or floating glass surfaces into the portfolio shell. A curved shape must be functionally or artifactually justified.

dos: Do let scale, rhythm, contrast, and authentic work produce the memorable moment.
Do maintain a stable reading direction for repeated projects and subprojects.
Do use hairlines and deliberate spacing to make every content group visibly begin and end.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and provide reduced-motion behavior for every nonessential transition.
Do preserve generous but purposeful mobile margins and keep controls visible by default.
donts: Don't use client imagery, palettes, or motifs as Josh King's site-wide brand identity.
Don't add eyebrow headings, gratuitous side borders, rounded-card grids, or decorative glass effects.
Don't fill empty space with arbitrary effects, illustrations, or prose; every addition must improve hierarchy, proof, or action.
Don't alternate repeated layouts without a meaningful content reason.
Don't make motion, gradients, or Three.js effects the product before they have a clear purpose and accessible fallback.
